expected_source_hash.description: Target intrinsic hash, never recursively dependency-bound. Restore stages carry separate effective/preparation hashes.

absence_delete_authority.description: Continuity only, never deletion consent. deletion_policy is an additional mandatory gate.

RestoreWorkflow.description: Retired-declaration restoration only. Final payload is reconstructed from the frozen blob at final_source_hash. Record receipts are ordinary commit receipts. No general second ACK.

QuotaObservation.description: assessed_units null until a receipt establishes assessment; it is not counter settlement.

ProjectionWork.description: Immutable receipt-linked dispatch descriptor, work_id is deterministic from receipt/artifact/input and is the existing transport run_id. No mutable mirror job status.

StoredApplyUnit.description: Local representation only. Expand each StoredPut.payload_ref from frozen_payloads before hashing or sending. Wire Put still requires payload.

DeleteApproval.description: not_required only if this plan has no inferred removals. held never authorizes a destructive unit. Count is exact D or null. No-delete overrides every value.
